title: Routed campus ticket: OSPF longest-prefix selection
summary: Verify why a more-specific OSPF route wins over a broader static route.
brief: EDGE-A has a broad static route for 10.20.0.0/16 and a learned OSPF route for the more-specific SITE-B LAN 10.20.20.0/24. Use route evidence and host ping to prove which route the simulator selects. This model evaluates longest-prefix selection before route source; it does not model OSPF metrics, LSAs, ECMP, or real packet timing.
objectives: Explain why the /24 wins over the /16
Verify SITE-A reaches SITE-B using the selected path
hints: Compare the destination address with both prefix lengths.
The longest matching prefix is considered before route source preference.
Use show ip route and host ping as complementary evidence.
